themes.name: World-action models for embodied AI
themes.summary: These papers learn or benchmark world models and action-conditioned dynamics for embodied agents, using video and 3D observations for tasks such as dexterous manipulation and sim-to-real skills. Methods range from action-prior learning and progressive visual planning to explicit world editing and long-term spatial memory.

themes.name: Time-series and physics-informed scientific ML
themes.summary: Papers develop neural solvers, emulators, and forecasting models for physical, biological, and climate systems, often with physics constraints or uncertainty. They cover PDE-based simulation, sparse linear solvers, time-series forecasting, and counterfactual scientific inference.

themes.name: Security and safety of LLM agents
themes.summary: This cluster studies attacks and defenses for LLM agents, including jailbreaks, prompt injection, multi-agent integrity, and policy compliance. Methods include information-theoretic attack analysis, certified multi-source integrity, and benchmarks for bias and source preference.

themes.name: Post-training and distillation for LLMs and VLA
themes.summary: Papers improve policy optimization and distillation from teacher models during or after reinforcement learning, including on-policy latent distillation, adaptive self-distillation, and reward modeling for agentic tasks. Work spans LLM reasoning, vision-language-action models, and reward hacking mitigation.

themes.name: Agent benchmarks for coding, computer-use, and tool workflows
themes.summary: New and harder benchmarks evaluate LLM agents on software engineering, desktop and web control, engineering-grade Simulink generation, and long-horizon tool use. They stress robustness, clarification, dense supervision, and multilingual multimodal web tasks.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference, KV-cache, and model compression
themes.summary: Work reduces inference and memory costs through quantization, pruning, sparsity, and KV-cache compression or reuse. It includes hardware-native sparse-quantized Mixture-of-Experts and post-training compression of dense and sigmoid networks.

themes.name: Flow matching and few-step diffusion sampling
themes.summary: Papers advance fast generative modeling with flow matching, rectified flows, constrained trajectory optimization, and few-step sampling for video, images, and scientific data. They address distribution matching, speculative sampling, and satisfaction-diversity tradeoffs.

themes.name: Continual learning, memory, and unlearning
themes.summary: This cluster tackles retention and removal of knowledge across distribution shifts, including continual adaptation for world models and low-rank methods, machine unlearning certificates, and state-space unlearning for non-stationary forecasting.

themes.name: Graph representation learning and graph-based retrieval
themes.summary: Papers develop graph neural networks, graph augmentation, and graph-based retrieval for structured, hypergraph, and biomedical data, including typed-decision calibration and symbolic graph reasoning.

themes.name: 3D and 4D reconstruction with Gaussian splatting
themes.summary: Methods reconstruct and edit dynamic 3D and 4D scenes with Gaussian splatting, octree representations, and inverse graphics. They include benchmarks for part-level editing and dynamic scene coding.

themes.name: Test-time compute allocation and routing
themes.summary: These papers adapt inference-time computation and model assignment through routing, calibration, and cost-aware search to improve reliability, fairness, or efficiency at test time.

themes.name: Multimodal LLMs for medical and scientific imaging
themes.summary: Papers apply vision-language and multimodal learning to medical and scientific images for diagnosis, segmentation, report generation, and uncertainty-aware triage, with attention to patient-level and domain-shift robustness.

highlights.title: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
highlights.authors: Zongxia Li, Yucheng Shi, Zhongzhi Li et al.
highlights.theme: Post-training and distillation for LLMs and VLA
highlights.why: It demonstrates a scalable self-distillation pipeline that converts harness-specific successes into general training trajectories, yielding large gains on terminal-task benchmarks.
highlights.key_result: Training on RSR's rewritten trajectories outperforms both the base model and direct trajectory SFT: compared with the base model, pass@3 increases from 57.0% to 74.2% on Terminal-Bench 2, from 1.5% to 9.1% on Terminal-Bench 4, from 39.0% to 63.0% on the self-curated Terminal-Bench Hard, and from 3.0% to 6.0% on the Software Terminal-Bench, while process reward on Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench rises from 0.21 to 0.29. news.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
Toward provably private learning from federated data
news.summary: Google Research announced a next-generation Federated Learning system that uses Trusted Execution Environments to provide fully verifiable and auditable data anonymization guarantees, with four core operational concepts: client-side data upload with published access policies, a KMS cluster of TEEs running RAFT consensus, TEE workload execution orchestrated via Federated Language, and fault-tolerant recovery. The post states Gboard has adopted the new system and reports substantially faster compute times than the previous FL system, which relied on mechanisms such as MF-DP-FTRL and secure aggregation.

news.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
news.summary: Google's September 2026 AI roundup covers the Gemini 4 Argon frontier model with a 1-million-token output limit, currently rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program, alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber. The month also included the Gemini 3.8 Live voice models, Googlebook pre-orders, the Gemini app on Windows, AlphaGenome Atlas human DNA mapping, global methane tracking from space, and Project Suncatcher for testing machine learning hardware in orbit.

news.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, with first cohorts from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency includes a multi-day in-person program followed by a 12-week residency, with participants earning the Claude Resident Engineer and then the Claude Frontier Deployed Engineer badge, the first expected in early 2027; cohorts run in San Francisco, New York and London.

news.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
news.summary: NVIDIA announced a DGX Spark configuration with 64GB of unified memory, available this month from Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI, retaining the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip and supporting up to 100-billion-parameter models on device. Two 64GB units can be clustered via ConnectX-7 and NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant to pool 128GB, support up to 200-billion-parameter models, and deliver up to 1.7x performance versus a single system in NVIDIA's Qwen 3.8 27B test.

news.title: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.
news.summary: Microsoft and Hugging Face released ThinkingBox, a benchmark that grades AI agents on terminal backend state and side effects across 507 stateful business workflows, each run 20 times, and reports pass@1, pass@20 and observed 20/20. In a common-set ablation of 121,680 valid trials across 12 LLM models, 79,853 attempts failed executable checks; 67.24% of those failures terminated cleanly with no final tool error, while the checks found wrong field values in 77.61%, unintended extra effects in 43.30%, and missing required effects in 25.36%.

news.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
news.summary: Ai2 open-sourced AstaBrief 8B, a report-generation model built on Qwen3-8B that turns a research question and retrieved literature excerpts into a cited report, along with its training data. In the full Asta pipeline, Fast mode averages 51.1 seconds per report versus 178.5 seconds for Thinking mode, about 3.5x faster; most training and evaluation was completed in 2025.

news.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
news.summary: ServiceNow CoreAI described AutoSynthData, a pipeline that uses a target model's failures and a stronger teacher's successes to generate validated training tasks, each consisting of a system specification, user prompt and verifier. The post specifies properties for tasks (feasibility, realism, difficulty) and verifiers (consistency, soundness, completeness), illustrating the pipeline with EnterpriseOps Gym (Malay et al., 2026).

news.title: Negotiating Ontological Boundaries in User-Authored Personal Sensing Systems
news.summary: Apple-affiliated researchers (with Stanford University) report a week-long exploratory study in which participants used one of two open-ended Wizard of Oz probes to train a personalized machine learning system on phenomena they defined themselves. The study identifies four sites where ontological boundaries were negotiated: the boundaries of a phenomenon, the subject as part of relations, what is signal and what is noise, and the objectivity of data.

news.title: Sweep thousands of leases for compliance using Amazon Quick and the Adjudicated Query pattern
news.summary: AWS introduced the Adjudicated Query design pattern, in which business users ask compliance questions in Amazon Quick while pass/fail decisions stay in a deterministic non-AI rules engine, with rules stored as versioned data. The post's example concerns a portfolio operator holding 50,000 leases and requires a completeness receipt asserting that compliant + in-breach + ambiguous + unreadable equals scanned, citing a claim such as checking all 22,910 Texas leases; the pattern is also presented as applicable to sanctions screening, insurance claims adjudication and export control.

news.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
Toward provably private learning from federated data
news.summary: Google Research announced a next-generation Federated Learning system that uses Trusted Execution Environments to provide fully verifiable and auditable data anonymization guarantees, with four core operational concepts: client-side data upload with published access policies, a KMS cluster of TEEs running RAFT consensus, TEE workload execution orchestrated via Federated Language, and fault-tolerant recovery. The post states Gboard has adopted the new system and reports substantially faster compute times than the previous FL system, which relied on mechanisms such as MF-DP-FTRL and secure aggregation.

news.title: The latest AI news we announced in September 2026
news.summary: Google's September 2026 AI roundup covers the Gemini 4 Argon frontier model with a 1-million-token output limit, currently rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program, alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber. The month also included the Gemini 3.8 Live voice models, Googlebook pre-orders, the Gemini app on Windows, AlphaGenome Atlas human DNA mapping, global methane tracking from space, and Project Suncatcher for testing machine learning hardware in orbit.

news.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, with first cohorts from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk. The Frontier Deployed Engineer Residency includes a multi-day in-person program followed by a 12-week residency, with participants earning the Claude Resident Engineer and then the Claude Frontier Deployed Engineer badge, the first expected in early 2027; cohorts run in San Francisco, New York and London.

news.title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
news.summary: NVIDIA announced a DGX Spark configuration with 64GB of unified memory, available this month from Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI, retaining the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip and supporting up to 100-billion-parameter models on device. Two 64GB units can be clustered via ConnectX-7 and NVIDIA Sync Cluster Assistant to pool 128GB, support up to 200-billion-parameter models, and deliver up to 1.7x performance versus a single system in NVIDIA's Qwen 3.8 27B test.

news.title: The Agent Said It Was Done. The Database Disagreed.
news.summary: Microsoft 和 Hugging Face 发布了 ThinkingBox，这是一个基准，在 507 个有状态业务工作流中根据终端后端状态和副作用对 AI agent 进行评分，每个工作流运行 20 次，并报告 pass@1、pass@20 和观察到的 20/20。在 12 个 LLM 模型的 121,680 次有效试验的公共集消融中，79,853 次尝试未通过可执行检查；其中 67.24% 的失败干净终止且没有最终工具错误，而检查发现 77.61% 的字段值错误，43.30% 的非预期额外副作用，以及 25.36% 的缺失必需副作用。

news.title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
news.summary: Ai2 开源了 AstaBrief 8B，这是一个基于 Qwen3-8B 的报告生成模型，可将研究问题和检索到的文献摘录转化为带引用的报告，并公开其训练数据。在完整的 Asta 流程中，Fast 模式平均每份报告耗时 51.1 秒，而 Thinking 模式为 178.5 秒，约快 3.5 倍；大部分训练和评估于 2025 年完成。

news.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
news.summary: ServiceNow CoreAI 描述了 AutoSynthData，一种利用目标模型的失败和更强教师模型的成功来生成经过验证的训练任务的流程，每个任务包含系统规范、用户提示和验证器。文章明确了任务的属性（可行性、真实性、难度）和验证器的属性（一致性、健全性、完备性），并用 EnterpriseOps Gym（Malay et al., 2026）说明该流程。

news.title: Negotiating Ontological Boundaries in User-Authored Personal Sensing Systems
news.summary: Apple-affiliated researchers (with Stanford University) report a week-long exploratory study in which participants used one of two open-ended Wizard of Oz probes to train a personalized machine learning system on phenomena they defined themselves. The study identifies four sites where ontological boundaries were negotiated: the boundaries of a phenomenon, the subject as part of relations, what is signal and what is noise, and the objectivity of data.

news.title: Sweep thousands of leases for compliance using Amazon Quick and the Adjudicated Query pattern
news.summary: AWS 引入了 Adjudicated Query 设计模式，其中业务用户在 Amazon Quick 中提出合规问题，而通过/失败决策保留在确定性的非 AI 规则引擎中，规则以版本化数据形式存储。文章示例涉及持有 50,000 份租约的投资组合运营商，要求出具完整性回执，证明 compliant + in-breach + ambiguous + unreadable 等于 scanned，并引用如检查全部 22,910 份 Texas 租约的声明；该模式还适用于制裁筛查、保险理赔裁定和出口管制。
